node.title: E22 residual minimality/multiplicity filter
node.statement: Apply the lower-scale nonadmissibility conditions |B_M'(R)|>=M' for every dyadic M'<M_i and the declared dyadic_profile_evaluation multiplicity to the residual-profile generating function, yielding the exact overlap formula O_{i,j} for every dyadic pair M_i<M_j. This is reduced to the proved finite lower-scale inclusion-exclusion identity and the remaining exact intersection-profile counts with multiplicity.
node.attack_surface: assembly from lower-scale inclusion-exclusion and the remaining intersection-profile formulas with pricing multiplicity
node.falsifier: a support passing the residual budget but failing minimality or multiplicity, or a minimal support removed by the filter
